'''Darth Malak's lightsaber''' was the personal weapon of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Malak|Malak]]. Malak constructed his [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith lightsaber]] some time after meeting the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]].<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> During the [[Jedi Civil War]], he would use it against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] he once fought alongside. Eventually, he would duel both his former Master [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Bastila Shan]] aboard the [[Leviathan (Interdictor-class cruiser)|''Leviathan'']]. He would once again use the weapon for the final time on the [[Star Forge]] during the [[Battle of Rakata Prime]] where he was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by Revan.<ref name="KOTOR" />
